editorial.blurb: A spacious Vietnamese gem on Lincoln Avenue where fresh pho, catfish clay pot, and lemongrass chicken keep regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive between 6-6:30pm to snag parking before it gets tight after 7pm; the pho broth and pork with egg rice are worth the timing.
signatureDishes: Stir Fry Chicken in Spicy Lemongrass
